messages:
maya.pm: Quick sync — we need to align on long-term topology decisions for multi-region + tenant shielding. Proposal sketch: 3 launch lanes (latency-sensitive, regulated, cost-optimized), phased rollout, and a clear customer-gating rubric. Who's in for drafting the decision canvas?

sam.eng: +1. I think the launch lanes make sense. Suggest a 2-phase rollout: pilot with 3 customers (one per lane) then broader Q1 ramp.

anika.prodops: We need explicit launch criteria: per-lane SLOs (p95 < target), migration window <= 24h, automated rollback signal, and an acceptance prompt-set for quality regressions.

liam.arch: Can we include model-aware routing as part of the latency lane? Route heavy-decoder models to local pairs, fall back to quantized variants. Low lift: routing table + model-variant metadata.

maya.pm: Good call. That would be a differentiator. Add a column in the canvas for "model compatibility / fallback variants".

eva.sales: Customer gating note — enterprise legal will ask about data residency for the regulated lane. We should include contract language and required certifications before cutover.

sam.eng: Operational checklist idea: capacity reservation per lane, eviction policy, and a burn-in window where we don't autoscale down for X days. Keep the pilot customers on dedicated slices.

anika.prodops: Launch checklist (first pass): 1) SLO validation in staging 2) Telemetry: per-tenant latency/cost 3) Migration docs + runbook 4) Rollout policy (canary %, time) 5) Legal/compliance signoff for regulated lane.

liam.arch: Small snippet to illustrate a routing predicate we could use:
```yaml
route: 
  - name: latency-lane
    match: tenant.annotations.latency == "high" or request.model in ["redwood-llama-8b", "llamav2-13b"]
    action: prefer_local_region
    fallback: quantized-compat
```

maya.pm: Love it. For the decision canvas I'd like columns: "customer ask", "lane mapping", "launch criteria", "rollback triggers", "estimated infra delta", "sales blockers". Who can draft the canvas by EOD Wednesday?

sam.eng: I can do a first pass by Tuesday EOD.

anika.prodops: I'll add the rollout/runbook bits and the telemetry dashboards.

devin.sre: Quick safety check — we'll need automated eviction thresholds tied to cost SLOs and a circuit to shift traffic cross-region. Also: confirm KMS workflows for Private customers in regulated lane.

maya.pm: Noted. devin, can you capture the SRE gating checklist?

devin.sre: Yes. I'll add: disaster rollback, region-failover drill, KV cache warmup monitoring, and throttling backfills.

eva.sales: Heads-up: I have two customers wanting the regulated lane pilot. I'll connect them to the pilot intake doc once the canvas and criteria are ready.

maya.pm: Great — timeline proposal: canvas draft Tue, SRE checklist Wed, legal/compliance items annotated Wed, internal go/no-go Fri. Pilot onboarding begins next sprint if green.

sam.eng: :thumbsup: sounds realistic. We'll also run cost sims per-tenant for the cost-optimized lane.

liam.arch: One more ask — add a small experiment for cross-region multi-tenant isolation: measure noisy-neighbor impact with mixed-model workloads. Results will feed the eviction policy.

anika.prodops: I'll add an experiment bucket in the canvas and assign owners.

maya.pm: Cool. Action items summarized: Sam = canvas draft; Anika = runbook + telemetry; Devin = SRE gating checklist; Liam = model-aware routing spec + experiment; Eva = customer intake. We'll reconvene Fri AM for go/no-go.

deploy-bot: Deployment status: staging topology-sim v0.3 deployed at 1800123468 — smoke tests passed.

maya.pm: Nice — thanks deploy-bot. If anyone finds a hard blocker post the short note here. Otherwise, see you Fri. :raised_hands:
